title: Rehearsal
description: The stage's rehearsal record, tmp/stage/rehearsal (#815): what the last rehearsal saw and judged, whole, written by src/main/rehearsal.py after corpus-yoga pipeline rehearse ran the pipelines over the stage. This schema lives beside its writer rather than under rsc/schema/, which is the data domain: the record is the repository's own, not corpus data.

stamp.description: the rehearsal's stamp, a label: its log, tmp/logs/pipeline/rehearse/<stamp>.log, shares it

commit.description: the commit the checkout stood at, as git rev-parse --short says it

dirty.description: how many entries git status --porcelain listed in the checkout; 0 is a clean tree

signature.description: the Signature triad, <machine>/<provider>/<session>, or the machine alone where the environment names no session (src/main/provider.py)

exit.description: the exit status of corpus-yoga pipeline run inside the rehearsal

units.description: every staged unit as the run began, by its address under tmp/stage/input; a unit staged later is absent, unseen by this rehearsal

digests.description: the unit's own digests as the run began (src/main/corpus.py, own_digests): each file's, and one of the listing of a directory's files; a unit whose digests are these now is the unit the rehearsal saw

source.description: the digest a converting step recorded of the unit's source, source.sha256 beside the conversion, where a step converted the datum before validating it

verdicts.description: each family's verdict on the unit, by the family as the pipeline declares it, at the latest version the run judged; empty where the run wrote none

version.description: the family's version the datum was judged against

datum_sha256.description: the digest of the datum judged: one of the unit's digests, or the conversion of its source

schema_sha256.description: the digest of the version file judged against; a promotion holds it to origin/main's

at.description: when the validation step wrote the verdict, a label

output.description: the validator's whole output, the log beside the verdict, kept where the verdict is invalid: the evidence a refused unit is
